defects.summary: Front-matter readers (semantic-router _split_frontmatter and recall-inject _parse_frontmatter) accept UTF-8-BOM / UTF-16LE as ordinary body text and lose name/description metadata.
No dotenv parser is shipped in this P2-competent worktree (census python-dotenv callsites=0).
Present engines were executed. pwsh ConvertFrom-Json/Yaml and CPython 3.10 tomllib are recorded BLOCKED with named runtime-absent errors, not folded into PASS.
matrix_errors now rejects empty parser lists and all-blocked matrices; both-states controls fire on those fixtures and stay silent on the live 15-row matrix.
Raw CRLF REGISTER.md still hashes differently from provenance; validate.py LF-normalises and exits 0 with no REACH-6 finding.
Archive remains invalid for blob-byte claims. Probe 2 measures the trap with a plumbing fixture (* text eol=crlf) and uses cat-file/show, not archive, as the blob.
Named probe scripts and hashed raw logs now exist under command-center/p2-wave/probes/BLD-0008/ and re-run to exit 0.
This unit registers via per-unit UNIT-ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json. Sibling BLD-0001 global --check redness is outside this unit.
